transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this course-approval meeting to order. We're here to review the proposed senior community-partnership capstone course for the fall term. As I understand it, the proposal currently describes this as a one-credit course assessed by a final reflective essay, combining supervised work with community organizations with academic reflection. Before we proceed, let's follow our standard round-robin checklist. I'd like to start with the faculty sponsor's report on any pilot and instructional findings, then move to the registrar for coding and transcript requirements, and finally to the career-learning coordinator for partner scheduling and capacity constraints. Once we've covered all of those, I'll record the final approval. Who'd like to begin?
